mapper.select: select from arc_archive a left join arc_category c on c.category_id=a.category_id where a.archive_id=#{archiveId} and a.del_flag='0' and a.create_by=#{ownerName}
select event_type eventType,actor_name actorName,event_time eventTime,detail from arc_audit_event where archive_id=#{archiveId} order by event_time desc,event_id desc
mapper.update: update arc_archive set title=#{title},forming_date=#{formingDate},category_id=#{categoryId}, category_code=#{categoryCode},secret_level=#{secretLevel},retention_code=#{retentionCode}, retention_name=#{retentionName},summary=#{summary},metadata_json=#{metadataJson},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where archive_id=#{archiveId} and version=#{version} and archive_status='DRAFT' and del_flag='0' and create_by=#{createBy}
update arc_archive set del_flag='1',version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where archive_id=#{archiveId} and version=#{version} and archive_status='SUBMITTED' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select next_value from arc_archive_sequence where category_id=#{categoryId} and forming_year=#{formingYear} for update
mapper.update: update arc_archive_sequence set next_value=next_value+1 where category_id=#{categoryId} and forming_year=#{formingYear}
